subject: Talent roster decision notes — QBR alignment
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Ashley Park <ashley@hirewell.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Talent roster decision notes — QBR alignment

Team —

Ahead of the QBR next week I want to lock the roster decisions that materially affect our capacity and OKRs for the next two quarters. Attached is the working slate (QBR_Talent_Slate_v3.xlsx) and the req rollup (Req_Rollup_09-12.pdf). Key asks:

- Please indicate APPROVE / HOLD / FREEZE for each req in the sheet by EOD Monday (9/14).
- If you approve a req for immediate backfill, call out whether we should open full-time or convert to a 6-month contractor to hit Q3 targets.
- For any headcount you mark APPROVE, include a short justification (OKR alignment or critical dependency).

High-level context: our QBR commitments require 2 additional SWE ICs on inference infra, one PM for platform integrations, and a renewed CS lead for a top enterprise account. Non-critical product-facing roles can be deferred. I want minimal movement after this round — these approvals will be the baseline for our hiring requests for the next 60 days.

I'll synthesize your inputs into a final plan and share with finance and recruiting ops on Tuesday.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
VP Product, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachments: QBR_Talent_Slate_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), Req_Rollup_09-12.pdf (pdf)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>

On Sat, Sep 12, 2026 at 10:12 AM Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Ahead of the QBR next week I want to lock the roster decisions that materially affect our capacity and OKRs for the next two quarters. Attached is the working slate (QBR_Talent_Slate_v3.xlsx) and the req rollup (Req_Rollup_09-12.pdf). Key asks:

Thanks for the clear framing. Quick notes inline on the sheet and a short summary here:

- SWE (Inference infra) x2: APPROVE for immediate backfill. These directly map to OKR infra reliability + latency improvement. Recommend FT hires; if market or budget stalls, convert the second role to a 6-month contractor (contractor ramp plan in comment B3).
- PM (Platform integrations): HOLD — scope can be parceled to two existing PMs for Q4 while we validate partner roadmap; revisit in Nov.
- CS Lead (Enterprise, north-america): APPROVE but request hiring with Tier-1 interview panel (this is customer-facing for CatalystAI).
- Data Scientist (embedding evaluation): FREEZE — deprioritized for next cycle.

Recruiting ops (Ashley) — can you confirm current pipeline for the two infra roles and an ETA to open if we pivot to contractor instead?

Sooj
Soojin Lee
Head of Platform Strategy, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

Attachment references: see inline comments in QBR_Talent_Slate_v3.xlsx

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Sep 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Talent roster decision notes — QBR alignment

Jonas / team —

I reviewed the sheet and agree with Soojin's recommendations with one exception: the PM (Platform integrations) should be APPROVED as a 0.6 FTE-focused hire (hire a senior contractor or part-time consultant) because we have two upcoming partner integrations that have legal and compliance touchpoints that will block launches if we wait. The budget impact is low if we go contractor-first.

Additionally, I approve the immediate backfill for req IR-204 (SWE, inference infra) — this is the critical backfill from the recent attrition and is blocking the latency OKR. Please mark IR-204 as PRIORITY-1 in the sheet.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Chief Engineering Officer, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

P.S. Ashley — please prioritize internal referrals first for IR-204 and escalate any panel scheduling conflicts to me directly.

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Ashley Park <ashley@hirewell.com>, Sourcing Ops <sourcing@venturehr.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Talent roster decision notes — QBR alignment (final plan)

Folks —

Thanks for the quick turn. I consolidated the votes and created a final actionable plan (attached final_talent_plan_20260914.pdf) with owners and deadlines. Summary of decisions:

- IR-204 (SWE, inference infra) — APPROVED, PRIORITY-1. Recruiter lead: Ashley. Target slate: internal referrals + 3 external L4 resumes by 9/21.
- IR-207 (SWE, inference infra) — APPROVED, CONDITIONAL. Open as FT if market feedback positive by 9/24; otherwise contractor (6 months) to start 10/05. Owner: Soojin.
- PM-INT-03 (Platform integrations) — APPROVED as 0.6 FTE contractor. Owner: Laura. Budget owner: Jonas (confirm budget reallocation).
- CS-ENT-01 (CS Lead) — APPROVED. Hiring panel to include a customer success director and the account AE. Owner: Vanessa.
- DS-014 (Data Scientist) — FREEZE. Removed from hiring slate for Q4.

Actions and due dates are in the attached PDF. Recruiting ops (Ashley / sourcing): please confirm candidate sourcing cadence and any cost delta for contractor vs FT by EOD Wednesday (9/16). Finance — I'll route the approved plan for headcount commit after we get recruiting confirmation.

Thanks — I'll keep a live doc and share the Drive folder link in the QBR packet.

Markus Klein
Head of Talent Operations, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com

Attachments: final_talent_plan_20260914.pdf (pdf)
